NEW ANIMALS

Play as Deer, Moose & Boar in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D

📅 November 17, 2026 • ⏱ 5 min read • 🏢 Gameyard Studio

Prepare for an entirely fresh survival dynamic! The latest update to Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D brings three extraordinary new playable animals to the roster: the agile Deer, the towering Moose, and the ferocious Wild Boar. Download the update now on the Google Play Store and test your survival instincts with unique abilities and playstyles.

1. The Swift Deer: Mastery of Agility and Stealth

The Deer brings unprecedented agility to Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D. Blessed with supreme leaping heights and rapid sprint acceleration, the Deer excels at evading apex carnivores like the Wolf and Panther. Key mechanics include:

  • Heightened Senses: Detect lurking predators through an expanded scent and auditory radar before they close in.
  • Stamina Burst: Outrun predators over long distances and navigate steep rocky ridges where larger carnivores struggle to follow.
  • Foraging & Grazing: Rejuvenate health and stamina by locating rare herbs, wild berries, and fresh river banks across Jungle and Savanna worlds.

2. The Mighty Moose: Forest Titan with Crushing Antlers

Do not mistake the Moose for passive prey. In Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D, the Moose represents one of the most physically imposing creatures in the wilderness. Featuring massive antler armaments and a thick winter coat, the Moose can go toe-to-toe with even the strongest grizzly bears and wolf packs.

  • Antler Ram Attack: Deliver high-impact kinetic headbutts that stun charging predators and knock down pursuing foes.
  • Waterway Superiority: Swim through deep rivers and marshlands faster than land predators, utilizing water bodies as tactical escape routes.
  • Territory Stomp: Clear surrounding ambushes with a ground-shaking hoof stomp that causes area-of-effect stagger damage.

3. The Wild Boar: Raw Aggression and Relentless Toughness

Tenacious, armored, and fiercely protective of its den, the Wild Boar is built for close-quarters brawling in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D. With its razor-sharp tusks and thick hide, the Boar can root for underground sustenance and counterattack any carnivore bold enough to challenge its feeding grounds.

Master All 3 New Beasts Today

Switch between predators and herbivores in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D. Unlock the Deer, Moose, and Boar on the Google Play Store right now!

▶ GET THE NEW ANIMALS ON GOOGLE PLAY

How to Unlock and Play the New Animals

All three animals can be selected directly from the main animal selection menu after updating your game client. Each new creature features full progression support—allowing you to evolve them from young juveniles into majestic prime specimens using the new Animal Growth System.

Share your favorite new creature or tell us which animal we should add next by visiting our Gameyard Suggestions Page!
